moment: Arrival at Hogwarts by night: castle on the cliff above the Black Lake, floating candles, a broomstick in flight
why: Unmistakable Hogwarts silhouette over a lake, Great Hall floating candles taken outdoors, a flying broom.

moment: The professor's prized 'astronaut pen' in its velvet case, with his stopwatch, in an old classroom
why: Ceremonial pen in a presentation box plus a stopwatch on a lecture desk reads as Virus's astronaut pen and his timed routine; could also be any academic-award still life.

moment: Frontier ranch at blood-red sunset, lone oak, cabin and fence, with X waypoints along a trail
why: Red-tinted sky, crows, ranch homestead and mountains match RDR2 key art; the X marks read like map waypoints or Dead Eye tags.

moment: Town bounty/wanted-poster board with one blank fresh notice pinned on top
why: Weathered wooden board with yellowed posters is a classic western bounty board, as in RDR2 towns; could be any western.

moment: Open sketchbook/journal: pencil railway track, ruled margin, taped note
why: Cream paper and pencil sketch could be Arthur Morgan's RDR2 journal, but nothing specific enough to name it.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct on the way to school
why: Red steam train on the curved stone viaduct above a Highland loch is the iconic Hogwarts Express shot.

moment: Same red-sunset ranch; X marks over birds in the sky like Dead Eye targeting
why: RDR2 palette and homestead, and the X tags over targets strongly echo the Dead Eye mechanic.

moment: Ghost ship looming at night with a treasure-map route and X overlay
why: Dark galleon in fog with lantern light plus a gold treasure map with an X and compass rose; could also be Sea of Thieves.

moment: Golden-hour river valley seen through a large dark cut-out shape
why: Landscape looks like RDR2-style American frontier at dusk, but the mask hides too much to name a world with confidence.

moment: Empty engineering lecture hall with a quadcopter drawn on the chalkboard
why: Stone-and-concrete colonnade campus (IIM Bangalore look) and a drone on the board recall ICE college and Joy Lobo's drone.

moment: A lone horse grazing in a sunset river valley under an oak
why: Painterly golden frontier landscape with a saddled horse is very RDR2 open-world.

moment: Great Hall enchanted night-sky ceiling with floating candles and broom trails
why: Candles hanging in a starry sky are the Great Hall ceiling; the streak with bristles reads as a broom.

moment: Moonlit harbour of tall ships at night, with a compass-to-X treasure route and skull
why: Port Royal/Tortuga-like harbour plus a compass, skull and X map route strongly evoke Jack Sparrow's world.

moment: Wanted/bounty board with a blank notice in focus
why: Same western bounty-board treatment as J004.

moment: The yellow scooter parked on the shore of Pangong Lake, Ladakh, at sunrise (the finale)
why: Yellow scooter beside the blue high-altitude lake is the climactic reunion setting of 3 Idiots.

moment: A home-built drone hovering in a stone-colonnade college courtyard
why: Campus architecture and a DIY drone echo ICE college and the drone subplot, but it also reads as a real engineering project photo.

moment: Same DIY drone over a campus lawn with concrete pergolas
why: Same reasoning as J016; less film-like, more real-world.

moment: Storm on the open sea, with the compass-and-skull treasure route
why: Stormy ocean plus pirate-map iconography; ocean alone would not identify it.

moment: Astronaut pen in its case beside a stopwatch, classroom window light
why: Same still life as J002.

moment: Floating candles in the dark, one candle singled out in a targeting bracket
why: Floating candles against a night sky; the UI bracket is site chrome, not film.

moment: Lecture-hall chalkboard with a drone sketch and a rising curve
why: Same campus lecture hall and drone motif as J010.

moment: A ship sailing into the sunset with a glowing wake (the green-flash ending feel)
why: Tall ship on the horizon at sunset with a luminous trail evokes the closing shots and the green flash.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolding, with moving footprints
why: Folded parchment, ribbon banner, hand-drawn borders and walking footprints are the Marauder's Map.

moment: The Black Pearl with tattered black sails in a storm at night
why: Ragged black sails, stern lanterns and fog are the Black Pearl's signature look.

moment: Yellow scooter at Pangong Lake, with a timeline of boxes overhead
why: Same finale setting as J015.

moment: Floating candles and broom trails across a starry sky
why: Great Hall ceiling motif repeated.

moment: Dark sea with a glowing turquoise wave and a lone tall ship on the horizon
why: Tall ship at night suggests pirates; the bioluminescent wave is less specific (could be Life of Pi-like).

moment: The gang's camp at sunset: wagon, canvas tents, horses, campfire stewpot, lake below
why: Covered wagon, hitched horses and campfire pot above a lake look like the Van der Linde camp (Horseshoe Overlook / Clemens Point).

moment: Same camp at dusk, lantern-lit tent and stewpot
why: Same camp as J028.

moment: Marauder's Map ink spreading on a Hogwarts floor under floating candles
why: Parchment with ink revealing itself and footprints, floating candles and a Gothic window onto a castle.

moment: Night camp: two tents and a campfire under the mountains
why: Fits the RDR2 camp sequence, but alone it is generic camping.

moment: Black Pearl under the moon, with Jack Sparrow's compass drawn in gold
why: Tattered-sail galleon plus the compass that does not point north.

moment: Marauder's Map corridors with footprints and broom marks
why: Parchment corridors with walking footprints are the Marauder's Map.

moment: Ghost ship in shadow with a compass and dotted route
why: Same ship and compass motif as J032.

moment: The Great Hall at Hogwarts, house tables set, candles floating
why: Long house tables, high table, Gothic window and floating candles.

moment: Chalkboard with a drone sketch and bar chart beside an arched stone window
why: Drone-on-chalkboard motif suggests the same college world, but the arched sandstone window is more generic old-university.

moment: Sketchbook spread with a crossed-out page-layout wireframe
why: Reads as a designer's notebook; nothing points to a specific film or game.

moment: Glowing wave and a lone tall ship on a night sea
why: Same as J027.

moment: The Great Hall with floating candles
why: Same as J035.
